column_description: VARCHAR(20). Unique operation registry identifier. PK.
EmergLevel_enum. Emergency level of the operation. Possible values: Black, Orange, Red, Yellow.
TEXT. Response phase during the operation. Possible values: Emergency, Initial, Reconstruction, Recovery.
TEXT. Operational status description. Possible values: Active, Completed, Planning, Scaling Down.
TEXT. Coordination center for the operation. Example: CC7649.
DATE. Date when the operation started. Example: 2025-01-26.
BIGINT. Estimated duration of the operation in days. Example: 12.
PriorityRank_enum. Priority rank of the operation. Possible values: Critical, High, Low, Medium.
ResourceAllocState_enum. Resource allocation status. Possible values: Critical, Limited, Sufficient.
TEXT. Supply flow status during the operation. Possible values: Disrupted, Stable, Strained.
